newsitem.title: USA: Scholastic says to form $200 mln rev group.
newsitem.headline: Scholastic says to form $200 mln rev group.

text.p: Scholastic Inc said Tuesday it is combining four divisions to form a new unit called Scholastic School Group with estimated revenues of $200 million. The company said the new unit will combine the sales force of its instructional publishing group, classroom magazines, professional publishing and the early childhood division into one operation that will sell Scholastic products to schools.
Previously, each of these divisions had its own sales force. The company was not immediately able to provide information on whether this consolidation involves layoffs.
Scholastic Inc is a subsidiary of Scholastic Corp.
